repair.content:
Multiply weights by n_o

For nested intervals use entry level V: V=U for lower one-sided, V=abs(2U-1) for equal-tailed. Exact signed empirical area is mean(V)-1/2; divide rank sum by N and use midpoint grid. Set entry level V=1 when the point never enters a credible set, which preserves the exact integral identity under misspecification.

State fallback only under suitable cost geometry/regularization; any detector requires new validation
